title: CKCAtelierRealSourceToLoomProjectionAdapter
clause: Implement real CKC/Atelier source-to-Loom projections and relations without synthetic blocks or duplicated CKC authority.

current_source_discovery: Inspect the stable merged WP-CKC product source, typed CKC/Atelier records, intake items, characters, sheet versions, moodboards, albums, folders, media and existing Loom bridge.
Use real persisted CKC/Atelier fixtures; do not infer completeness from synthetic Loom blocks or route names.
stop_conditions: MT-392 is not accepted or WP-CKC is not merged and validated.
CKC/Atelier canonical entity identity is ambiguous.
Projection design would make Loom independently mutable domain authority.

scope.summary: Connect actual CKC/Atelier Surreal records to Loom. CKC remains the domain authority and future navigation parent for Tailor; Loom owns cross-domain graph/search/backlink projections only. This MT does not implement Tailor or Studio features.
forbidden_paths: Synthetic ckc_character or ckc_moodboard Loom blocks as proof
Loom-owned copy of CKC character/sheet/moodboard state
acceptance_criteria: The typed projection registry supports real CKC/Atelier sources including intake item, character, character-sheet version, moodboard, pose/media reference, album, folder and source record as present in stable main.
Creating/updating/deleting/restoring a real CKC source produces an idempotent Loom projection and typed native relation with source identity, project, version, provenance and repair metadata.
CKC remains the sole mutable domain authority in SurrealDB; Loom projection mutation APIs reject attempts to edit CKC-owned fields and navigate to the owning CKC surface.
Existing Loom/AssetStore/Atelier media references are reused; no duplicate file, note, tag, album or folder authority is introduced.
Cross-project source projections require explicit shared-access relations and preserve source scope through search, graph, preview and diagnostics.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal CKC source create/update/delete/restore to Loom projection tests using stable-main domain APIs.
Run negative tests proving synthetic blocks cannot satisfy projection linkage and Loom cannot mutate CKC authority.
Run cross-project share/revoke, restart and projection repair tests with independent Surreal reread.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private CKC characters, sheets and media remain hidden from another member despite shared project membership.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged CKC source/projection/asset IDs fail closed.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Loom projection, thumbnail, backlink and search scope cannot exceed CKC source scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Open projections and cached CKC previews invalidate after grant/context change.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Crawler/remote source identity never grants local CKC/Loom access.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Character names, sheet versions, album counts, thumbnails and projection status do not reveal denied sources.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: source/project/update/delete/repair/deny events with CKC and Loom identities
projection version, lag, dangling source and repair health
CKC/Loom navigation and media-render recovery correlation

risk_if_missed: CKC and Loom remain connected only by synthetic test blocks or narrow intake-item links, preventing real character/media reuse.

risks: Synthetic blocks pass tests without real CKC source linkage.

sources: Stable merged WP-CKC source and MT-010 contract
Digital asset and character-pipeline provenance patterns
research_provenance.selected_approach: Typed repairable Loom projections over real CKC/Atelier Surreal records while CKC retains domain authority.
